title: Top productivity hacks for aspiring psychologists and mental health professionals

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能获得收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我自己的独家支持套餐，不收取额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时在线。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将迈向由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and it's lovely to have you here listening.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，很高兴你能来这里收听。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to everybody who's been so welcoming and enthusiastic and encouraging about the new book that was published last week, the Aspiring Psychologist Collective.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢所有对上周出版的新书《有抱负的心理学家集体》表示热烈欢迎、热情和鼓励的人。

sentences.en: It's really lovely to see so many of you excited to get your hands on it and to read it.
sentences.zh: 看到你们这么多人渴望拿到并阅读它，真的非常高兴。

sentences.en: So I do hope that you're finding that useful if you've got your copy already.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你已经有了副本，我希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: If you haven't, there is always time, always time.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有，永远都来得及，永远都不晚。

sentences.en: But why not dive in and do that now?
sentences.zh: 但为什么不现在就行动起来呢？

sentences.zh: 你可以在亚马逊上买到，有平装版、电子书版或精装版。

sentences.en: The hardback is in full colour, which is why the price is a little bit steeper than might be ideal.
sentences.zh: 精装版是全彩的，这就是为什么价格可能比理想的要贵一点。

sentences.en: I thought it would be nice to put together a hardback colour option because they don't let you do a paperback black and white and a paperback colour.
sentences.zh: 我想做一本精装彩版应该挺不错的，因为他们不允许同时做黑白平装和彩色平装。

sentences.en: But I didn't quite realise how expensive it would be to make it colour.
sentences.zh: 但我没完全意识到制作彩色版会这么贵。

sentences.en: So it is a thing of beauty.
sentences.zh: 所以它真的是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: You can also get colour in the e-book, but the hardback is in glorious technicolour.
sentences.zh: 你也可以买彩色电子书，但精装版是绚丽的全彩。

sentences.en: It is a thing of beauty.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: So if your department has some spare cash or, you know, got someone who wants to spend a little bit of money on you for Christmas,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你们部门有一些多余的资金，或者，你知道的，有谁想在圣诞节为你花点小钱，

sentences.en: then the hardback is lovely, but the content is all the same apart from the colour.
sentences.zh: 那么精装版很可爱，除了颜色之外，内容都是一样的。

sentences.en: So take your pick, see what works best for you, paperback, e-book or hardback.
sentences.zh: 所以任君选择，看看哪个最适合你，平装版、电子书版或精装版。

sentences.zh: 如果你想参加抽奖，赢取与我进行一对一心理学指导的机会，

sentences.zh: 完全可以，只要在2022年9月1日到2022年10月31日万圣节期间购买任何一本《临床心理学家集体》的书，

sentences.en: and Halloween the 31st of October 2022 and then sending me a unique proof of purchase to book at goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk
sentences.zh: 然后将唯一的购买凭证发送至 book@goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk

sentences.en: And the details for that email address, in case you missed it, are in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了，那个电子邮件地址的详细信息在节目简介中。

sentences.en: But it's book at goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk.
sentences.zh: 但它是 book@goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk。

sentences.en: And you can also score some bonus point entries as well.
sentences.zh: 你还可以获得一些额外的积分奖励。

sentences.zh: 如果你确实是在亚马逊上买的，那么你可以给我留下一条已验证的购买评论，然后在完成后将证明发给我。

sentences.zh: 你可能在任何时候购买了《临床心理学家集体》或《有抱负的心理学家集体》的书。

sentences.zh: 但如果你在这个时间段内为我写了评论，就意味着只要你在9月1日到10月31日之间通知我，你就可以参加比赛。

sentences.en: And you can also score some bonus entries by leaving the audio testimonials about either the Clinical Psychologist Collective book or the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 你还可以通过留下关于《临床心理学家集体》书或《有抱负的心理学家集体》书的音频感言来获得一些额外条目。

sentences.zh: 或者如果你两本都买过，你可以两本都做。

sentences.en: That would be marvellous.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.zh: 你还可以获得两份额外奖励。

sentences.zh: 如果你访问我的网站 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk 斜杠 podcast，你只需点击一个链接，就会打开一个名为 Bonjoro 的精彩网站。

sentences.en: And it literally is just point and click.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是指点一下，点击一下。

sentences.en: You know, you just pop your name in, pop your webcam on and go for it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你只要填上名字，打开网络摄像头，就可以开始了。

sentences.zh: 如果你只乐意录制音频，那就这样做。

sentences.en: But you need to do that and you need to get it done before the 31st of October because that is when the contest ends.
sentences.zh: 但你需要这样做，并且必须在10月31日之前完成，因为那是比赛结束的时间。

sentences.en: And you could use this session if you win, which will take place on the 1st, 2nd or 3rd of November, to think about your doctorate in clinical psychology application form
sentences.zh: 如果你赢了，你可以利用这次将于11月1日、2日或3日进行的会议来考虑你的临床心理学博士申请表

sentences.en: or another professional psychology application form.
sentences.zh: 或其他专业心理学申请表。

sentences.en: Or if you're qualified or not yet ready to apply, we could use that for thinking about just coaching and ways to help you be your optimal best self.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你已经获得资格，或尚未准备好申请，我们可以用它来思考辅导和帮助你成为最佳状态的方法。

sentences.en: So dive in and yeah, take advantage and enter the competition.
sentences.zh: 所以，加入进来吧，是的，抓住机会参加比赛。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: So as you may have noticed, I do have lots of plates spinning.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我手头有很多事情要忙。

sentences.en: So for those of you who followed me on the podcast for a while, you might well know that I am a mummy.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些关注我播客一段时间的朋友，你们可能很清楚我是一位妈妈。

sentences.en: I'm a mummy to two young children.
sentences.zh: 我是两个幼童的妈妈。

sentences.en: I'm also a clinician still.
sentences.zh: 我依然是一名临床医生。

sentences.en: So I do still see people for one-to-one trauma therapy usually, but also do anxiety, depression and grief too.
sentences.zh: 因此，我仍然为一对一创伤疗法看病人，通常也处理焦虑、抑郁和悲伤。

sentences.en: So I do that, but I also support aspiring psychologists, you lovely folk, and I also create books, don't I?
sentences.zh: 所以我做这些，但我也支持有抱负的心理学家，也就是你们这些可爱的人，而且我也创作书籍，对吧？

sentences.en: And so, you know, people are like, Marianne, how do you get enough time in the day?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，人们会问，玛丽安，你怎么能在一天里抽出这么多时间？

sentences.en: How do you organise yourself to get everything done, to get everything sorted?
sentences.zh: 你怎么组织自己把事情都做完，把一切都安排妥当？

sentences.en: And so I thought that would be a really useful conversation for us to have together today about ways we can organise ourselves or help support ourselves optimally
sentences.zh: 所以我想这对我们来说是一个非常有用的对话，我们可以一起探讨如何组织自己或支持自己，

sentences.en: to be our best energetic, energised, productive selves.
sentences.zh: 以达到最佳状态、充满活力和高效率。

sentences.en: So I've no idea how long today's podcast episode is going to be.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道今天的播客节目会有多长。

sentences.en: I've got a vague idea of the top tips that I'm going to go through.
sentences.zh: 我对我要讲的顶级秘诀有一个大致的了解。

sentences.en: Written myself a list, which I've left just out of my reach.
sentences.zh: 我给自己写了一张清单，但刚好放在我够不着的地方。

sentences.en: So I'm going to grab my list, hold the line, caller.
sentences.zh: 所以我要去拿我的清单，请别挂断，呼叫者。

sentences.en: Seamless, I'm back and I've got the liSt.
sentences.zh: 太丝滑了，我回来了，清单在手。

sentences.en: So one of my main strategies for organising myself, for kind of making sense of what might feel like organised chaos if it wasn't for this one super-duper top tip,
sentences.zh: 因此，我组织自己、理清那些若非有此绝招便会显得井然有序的混乱感的主要策略之一是，

sentences.en: is that I used to work in a service which employed the choice and partnership approach, also abbreviated often as CAPA.
sentences.zh: 我过去曾在一家采用选择与合作方法的机构工作，通常也简称CAPA。

sentences.en: And I know that still runs in certain children and young people's services, which was the type of service that I was working in.
sentences.zh: 我知道这仍在某些儿童和青少年服务中运行，这也是我当时工作的服务类型。

sentences.en: And in that service, it worked wonderfully for us because we were all quite compliant with the different ways of working.
sentences.zh: 在那项服务中，它对我们来说运作得非常完美，因为我们都相当遵守不同的工作方式。

sentences.en: But in case you haven't heard of a CAPA service, let me briefly go through the basic tenets for that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你没听说过CAPA服务，让我简要介绍一下其基本原则。

sentences.en: So depending on how many hours a week you work, it is closely calculated for how many clinical face-to-face hours
sentences.zh: 因此，根据你每周工作的小时数，会精确计算出你每周需要完成多少临床面对面小时数

sentences.en: it is expected of you to be able to do to be working at your full capacity.
sentences.zh: 才能达到满负荷工作状态。

sentences.en: And you pick up new clients at a set ratio depending on your hours.
sentences.zh: 根据你的工作时间，你将按设定的比例接诊新客户。

sentences.en: So when I first started with the team, I was full-time.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚加入这个团队时，我是全职的。

sentences.en: And that meant that I would, for three weeks out of four, I would pick up a new client.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在四周中有三周，我会接一个新客户。

sentences.en: And it's always in the same slot.
sentences.zh: 它总是在同一个时间段。

sentences.en: So for me, it was a Thursday at 2pm.
sentences.zh: 对我和来说，那是周四下午2点。

sentences.en: So for three out of the four, and if it was five Thursdays in a month, it was three out of five.
sentences.zh: 所以在四周中的三周，如果一个月有五个星期四，那就是五分之三。

sentences.en: For three out of those four or five Thursdays, I would pick up a new client.
sentences.zh: 在那四五个星期四中的三个里，我会接一个新客户。

sentences.en: And that's not a client that I'm choosing to see.
sentences.zh: 这不是我主动选择去见的客户。

sentences.en: That was a client that following assessment, following the choice appointment, which was an assessment, if they were deemed to need the service,
sentences.zh: 那是经过评估、经过选择预约（这是一项评估）后，如果他们被认为需要这项服务，

sentences.en: then they were dropped in with the next available choice clinician.
sentences.zh: 那么他们就会被安排给下一个可用的选择临床医生。

sentences.en: So that might have been me, but it could have been someone else in the team as well.
sentences.zh: 所以那可能是我，但也可能是团队中的其他人。

sentences.en: So I always knew that I had to be having throughputs, had to be not a long-term service, that people were always having a goals-based service.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是知道我必须有吞吐量，不能提供长期服务，人们总是接受基于目标的服务。

sentences.en: But what was really useful about this service was that all of the clinicians had job plans that were unique and bespoke to them.
sentences.zh: 但这项服务真正有用的是，所有临床医生都有独特且量身定制的工作计划。

sentences.en: And those job plans helped us to make sure we were using the available rooms optimally as well.
sentences.zh: 这些工作计划帮助我们确保以最佳方式利用可用房间。

sentences.en: So as I reflect back on that now, there were certain times in certain clinics, so certainly Thursday afternoons, I had set rooMs.
sentences.zh: 当我现在回想起来，在某些诊所的某些时间，比如周四下午，我有固定的房间。

sentences.en: I always quite liked the same room as well.
sentences.zh: 我也总是很喜欢同一个房间。

sentences.en: So they'd be kind to me and give me the same room creature of habit where possible.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会对我好一点，尽可能给我安排同一个作为习惯动物的房间。

sentences.en: And, you know, there were set clinics.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，有固定的诊所。

sentences.en: So I would always do choice assessments on a Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是在周三早上做选择评估。

sentences.en: So I would do in my job plan, two choice appointments.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在我的工作计划中做两个选择预约。

sentences.en: So one was at 9.30 and one was at 11.
sentences.zh: 一个在9点30分，另一个在11点。

sentences.en: And then I would use the afternoon of that time, usually to write those reports.
sentences.zh: 然后我会利用那段时间的下午，通常用来写那些报告。

sentences.en: So they were all done and dusted within the same day.
sentences.zh: 这样它们都在同一天内完成了。

sentences.en: But that was all blocked in.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是安排好的。

sentences.en: Admin time for the choice appointments was in my job plan.
sentences.zh: 选择预约的行政时间在我的工作计划中。

sentences.en: So it wasn't like I was trying to magically create time for admin.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是我试图凭空创造行政时间。

sentences.en: It was there, OK?
sentences.zh: 它就在那里，好吗？

sentences.en: And similarly, a Friday afternoon for me, seeing clients on a Friday afternoon where you might suddenly get a safeguarding issue at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 同样地，对我和来说，周五下午如果要在周五下午见客户，你可能会在下午4点突然遇到保障问题，

sentences.en: and I finished at 4.30 because of my commute, that was not for me.
sentences.zh: 而因为我要通勤，我4点半下班，这对我来说不合适。

sentences.en: So I made sure in my job plan that I had a clinic with rooms booked on a Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我确保在我的工作计划中，周五早上安排有预订房间的诊所。

sentences.en: But on a Friday afternoon, that was administration for issues related to my clients.
sentences.zh: 但在周五下午，那是处理与我客户相关问题的行政工作。

sentences.en: If I was writing letters or if there was any additional referrals that I needed to use to write for the choice appointments for the assessments.
sentences.zh: 如果我在写信，或者如果有任何额外的转诊需要我为选择评估来写。

sentences.en: So I know it can be common in services where we're doing assessments that we just haven't been able to factor in the time to write reports.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道在做评估的服务中很常见，我们只是无法将写报告的时间考虑在内。

sentences.en: But if that's the case, you know, I think we're potentially setting ourselves up to fail and to be feeling quite overwhelmed and distressed and to feel like we're not managing,
sentences.zh: 但如果是这样，你知道的，我认为我们可能是在自取灭亡，会感到相当不知所措和痛苦，并觉得我们应付不过来，

sentences.en: we're not coping, there's too much on our plate.
sentences.zh: 我们应接不暇，事情太多了。

sentences.en: So if you're regularly doing assessments or perhaps supporting qualified members of staff with assessments and then helping out with the assessment report writing,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你经常做评估，或者协助有资格的员工进行评估，然后帮忙写评估报告，

sentences.en: there needs to be time in your diary where you're going to do that.
sentences.zh: 你的日程表里需要有你要做这件事的时间。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you're going to be constantly squeezing, you know, it might be squeezing your lunchtime,
sentences.zh: 否则，你将不得不不断地挤压，你知道的，这可能会挤压你的午休时间，

sentences.en: it might be squeezing your start times or your finish times to get more hours in the day.
sentences.zh: 它可能会挤压你上班或下班的时间，以便在一天中挤出更多的时间。

sentences.en: So really have a look at what jobs you're doing every week.
sentences.zh: 所以好好看看你每周都在做什么工作。

sentences.en: And similarly, supervision should ideally be in your job plan and should be a consistent, repeatable endeavour.
sentences.zh: 同样，督导理想情况下也应该纳入你的工作计划中，并且应该是一项持续的、可重复的工作。

sentences.en: OK, so mine certainly is.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以我的肯定是这样的。

sentences.en: And similarly, if you're doing any meetings that you have to go to, then that should be in your job plan.
sentences.zh: 同样，如果你要参加任何必须出席的会议，那也应该在你的工作计划中。

sentences.en: And does that happen?
sentences.zh: 这会发生吗？

sentences.en: You know, if the meeting is not that productive, not that energetic, do you need to be there every time or could you job plan it that across the team you share the load?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果会议不是那么有成效、不是那么有活力，你需要每次都出席吗，或者你可以将其规划为整个团队分担工作？

sentences.en: So you might go every other week or one in four or three in four.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会每隔一周去一次，或者四分之一或四分之三。

sentences.en: And then, you know, the fourth one you use as time to to do that admin.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，第四次你用作做行政工作的时间。

sentences.en: You know, you're not asking for the moon on a stick.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你并不是在要求不可能的事。

sentences.en: As they say, you're just asking for enough time to be able to do your job well,
sentences.zh: 正如他们所说，你只是要求有足够的时间把工作做好、

sentences.en: safely, robustly to be able to do what you need to do.
sentences.zh: 安全、稳健地完成你需要做的事情。

sentences.en: So if you're learning a particular skill or approach and you need to do reading or you're doing research, could you look at trying to include that within your job plan?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在学习某项特定的技能或方法，需要阅读或做研究，你能考虑尝试将其纳入你的工作计划中吗？

sentences.en: So certainly when I was an aspiring psychologist and I would attend assistant psychologist meetings
sentences.zh: 当然，当我还是一个有抱负的心理学家时，我会参加助理心理学家会议

sentences.en: and I would also attend research meetings, then they would have been job planned if I was using job plans at that time.
sentences.zh: 我也会参加研究会议，如果当时我使用工作计划的话，这些都会被纳入计划中。

sentences.en: Because those job plans, you know, ideally are being agreed by your supervisor and or manager.
sentences.zh: 因为这些工作计划，你知道的，理想情况下是得到你的主管和或经理同意的。

sentences.en: They're saying, yes, those those are important issues for us.
sentences.zh: 他们在说，是的，这些对我们来说是重要的问题。

sentences.en: So we do see that that's really important.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实认为这非常重要。

sentences.en: And, you know, I still use a job plan now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我现在仍然在使用工作计划。

sentences.en: So I still have Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以我的周一仍然如此。

sentences.en: So I have Mondays and Fridays where I do largely admin.
sentences.zh: 我有周一和周五，主要用来处理行政事务。

sentences.en: I do things like today's a Friday.
sentences.zh: 我做一些事情，比如今天是星期五。

sentences.en: I'm doing a podcast and I do the editing around that.
sentences.zh: 我在做播客，并围绕它进行剪辑。

sentences.en: And I might write for the media and I might create content on Mondays and Fridays for my aspiring psychologist membership
sentences.zh: 我可能会为媒体写稿，我可能会在周一和周五为我的有抱负的心理学家会员创作内容

sentences.en: and, you know, try to do my non-client stuff on those days.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，尽量在那些日子里做非客户的事情。

sentences.en: But Tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursday mornings, I do see clients.
sentences.zh: 但周二、周三和周四早上，我确实要见客户。

sentences.en: So I run clinics.
sentences.zh: 所以我开诊所。

sentences.en: I run three clinics, 9.15, 10.15 and 11.15.
And that's that's predictable and repeatable.
sentences.zh: 这是可预测且可重复的。

sentences.en: And I always have time to do my notes in between those sessions unless they're overly complicated.
sentences.zh: 除非事情过于复杂，否则我总是有时间在这些会议之间写笔记。

sentences.en: But then I make time to do that before I stop for lunch.
sentences.zh: 但随后我会在午休前抽出时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: So I don't want any leftover projects.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想留下任何未完成的项目。

sentences.en: You know, I want to be able to stop for lunch.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我想停下来吃午饭。

sentences.en: And I've always stopped for lunch in whatever service I've worked in.
sentences.zh: 而且我在我工作过的任何服务机构里总是会停下来吃午饭。

sentences.en: I believe I've been told that I have a very good impact on team lunching and sociability because I always stop.
sentences.zh: 我相信有人曾对我说过，我在团队聚餐和社交方面发挥了很好的作用，因为我总是会停下来。

sentences.en: So people are like, oh, Marianne's there.
sentences.zh: 所以大家会觉得，哦，玛丽安在那儿。

sentences.en: I'll sit down with her, you know, and we'll eat our salads together.
sentences.zh: 我会和她坐在一起，你知道的，我们一起吃沙拉。

sentences.en: Or in my most recent NHS service, I was known for Chippy Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 或者在我最近的NHS服务中，我以“薯条星期二”而闻名。

sentences.en: So every now and then I'd be like, come on, let's, you know, there's a great chippy nearby.
sentences.zh: 所以每隔一段时间我就会说，来吧，我们去，你知道的，附近有一家很棒的炸鱼薯条店。

sentences.en: And on a Tuesday, they do a great pie, chips and sauce deal.
sentences.zh: 而且在星期二，他们有很棒的派、薯条和酱汁套餐。

sentences.en: So I would go for chicken and mushroom pie, the most amazing chips and curry sauce.
sentences.zh: 所以我通常会点鸡肉蘑菇派，还有最棒的薯条和咖喱汁。

sentences.en: And it would be like 350.
sentences.zh: 而且只要3.50英镑。

sentences.en: And so I'd like try and get people in advance to sign up for sitting down and having Chippy Tuesday with me.
sentences.zh: 所以我会试着提前让大家报名，和我一起坐下来享受“薯条星期二”。

sentences.en: And it was just really, really good.
sentences.zh: 真的非常、非常棒。

sentences.en: And so, you know, my lunchtime, usually 12.30 till one when I was in NHS services, was happening every day.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我在NHS工作时，我的午休时间通常是12点半到1点，每天都在进行。

sentences.en: I was bringing my lunch with me.
sentences.zh: 我随身带着午饭。

sentences.en: You know, I was accountable.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我有责任心。

sentences.en: I was making that usually the evening before so that it would nourish me for the day.
sentences.zh: 我通常在前一天晚上就把午饭准备好，这样它能为我提供一整天的营养。

sentences.en: So I'm a salad eater generally.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上是个爱吃沙拉的人。

sentences.en: I don't eat Chippy Tuesdays every Tuesday, but they were delicious.
sentences.zh: 我并不是每个星期二都吃炸鱼薯条，但它们确实很美味。

sentences.en: And if I still worked there, I would still be instigating Chippy Tuesday because the chips are incredible.
sentences.zh: 如果我还倒在那里工作，我依然会发起“薯条星期二”，因为那里的薯条太不可思议了。

sentences.en: You know, you're just a really good Chippy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那真是一家很棒的炸鱼薯条店。

sentences.en: And if you're not listening to this in the UK and you're like, what is she saying?
sentences.zh: 如果你听这个播客时不在英国，心里可能会想：她在说什么？

sentences.en: What is she saying?
sentences.zh: 她在说什么？

sentences.en: A Chippy?
sentences.zh: 炸鱼薯条店？

sentences.en: What is a Chippy?
sentences.zh: 什么是炸鱼薯条店？

sentences.en: A Chippy T.
sentences.zh: 薯条T。

sentences.en: So that's when I was in South Wales.
sentences.zh: 所以那是我在南威尔士的时候。

sentences.en: My friends from Lancashire introduced me to the term Chippy T.
sentences.zh: 我来自兰开夏郡的朋友向我介绍了“薯条T”这个词。

sentences.en: Chippy.
sentences.zh: 炸鱼薯条店。

sentences.en: It's a fish and chip shop in case you're not familiar with Chippy T.
sentences.zh: 如果你对“薯条T”不熟悉，它其实就是一家炸鱼薯条店。

sentences.en: Um, did you ever think that you'd hear me talk about Chippy T's and Chippies so much?
sentences.zh: 呃，你有没有想过你会听到我这么多谈论“薯条T”和炸鱼薯条店？

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没想过。

sentences.en: I didn't know that was going to be my plan for today.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这会是我今天的计划。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, it's important to stop.
sentences.zh: 呃，不过是的，停下来休息一下很重要。

sentences.en: It's important to look after yourself and to give yourself that appropriate self-care.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己，给自己适度的自我关怀，这非常重要。

sentences.en: So you need to make sure your job planning, your lunch break, job planning, your start and finish times.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要确保做好工作规划，包括午休规划、工作开始和结束时间。

sentences.en: Um, because that helps make sure that you're not overloaded.
sentences.zh: 呃，因为这有助于确保你不会超负荷工作。

sentences.en: You know, if there's a massive waiting list,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果有一个庞大的等待名单，

sentences.en: then you can absolutely be moved by that distress and think about what clever ways you can work in as you and as part of the team to reduce that workload.
sentences.zh: 那么你绝对会为这种困境所触动，并思考你可以作为个人以及团队成员采取什么聪明的办法来减轻这种工作负担。

sentences.en: But, you know, seeing a massive amount of face-to-face clients, and I absolutely appreciate that for many of you listening,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，面对大量的面对面客户——我完全理解在座的许多人，

sentences.en: certainly if you're listening to this working in IACT services, you might well not have this flexibility.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你是在IAPT（心理治疗改善访问）服务中工作，你很可能没有这种灵活性。

sentences.en: So I know certain people in certain services are seeing, you know, 70, 80, 90% face-to-face time, but that is, that is going to be very difficult to achieve long term.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道某些服务中的某些人，你知道的，有70%、80%、90%的时间都在进行面对面工作，但这从长远来看将是非常难以实现的。

sentences.en: That's going to lead to burnout.
sentences.zh: 那会导致职业倦怠。

sentences.en: And you might just need to look at where you can factor in some self-care around that and you need to make sure you're having regular supervision and that you're able to talk through the impact of this level of clinical work.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要审视自己在哪些方面可以围绕这些工作融入一些自我关怀，并且你需要确保自己有规律地接受督导，能够倾诉这种水平的临床工作所带来的影响。

sentences.en: So when I was employed in AA level, um, which in case you're not familiar with bandings, um, the NHS agenda for change bandings, um,
sentences.zh: 所以当我受雇于8A级时，呃——如果你对职级不熟悉的话，呃，NHS变革议程的职级，呃，

sentences.en: usually have numbers and sometimes letters to denote which, um, which level of pay you're on, uh, which grade.
sentences.zh: 通常有数字，有时还有字母，来表明你处于哪个薪酬级别，呃，哪个档次。

sentences.en: So band seven is where you qualify usually, um, when you qualify as a clinical psychologist and a counselling psychologist, um, and band eight A is usually a level above.
sentences.zh: 所以7级通常是你刚获得资格的级别，呃，当你获得临床心理学家和咨询心理学家的资格时，呃，而8A级通常是高一个级别。

sentences.en: And so when I was recruited to band eight A, I was recruited to be able to do 50% face-to-face time.
sentences.zh: 因此，自我被招聘到8A级岗位时，我的招聘要求是能够进行50%的面对面工作时间。

sentences.en: Um, but when I started that role, I was told by the others in the team, well, it's not really possible.
sentences.zh: 呃，但我刚开始那个角色时，团队里的其他人告诉我，这其实是不可能的。

sentences.en: You can't really do it because you can't get the rooMs.
sentences.zh: 你根本做不到，因为你借不到房间。

sentences.en: And I was like, I am job planning this.
sentences.zh: 而我说：我在做工作规划。

sentences.en: I am doing this.
sentences.zh: 我在做这件事。

sentences.en: You want 50% you're getting 50%.
sentences.zh: 你们要50%，你们就能得到50%。

sentences.en: Um, and I went out across the truSt.
sentences.zh: 呃，我在整个信托基金机构到处跑。

sentences.en: I saw people in a library.
sentences.zh: 我在图书馆接待过客户。

sentences.en: I saw people in a health center.
sentences.zh: 我在健康中心接待过客户。

sentences.en: I saw people in, um, a different psychiatric base.
sentences.zh: 我在，呃，不同的精神科基地接待过客户。

sentences.en: So I was like, madam peripatetic.
sentences.zh: 所以我简直就像个“巡回夫人”。

sentences.en: I was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我无处不在。

sentences.en: So when I first started that role, I was four days a week.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚开始那个岗位时，我是每周工作四天。

sentences.en: And when I went back after my second baby, I was three days a week.
sentences.zh: 当我生完第二个孩子回去上班时，我是每周工作三天。

sentences.en: But when I was four days a week, I was in four different locations, five different locations, actually, because there was no rooms available in my clinic base.
sentences.zh: 但当我每周工作四天时，我在四个不同的地点工作，实际上是五个不同的地点，因为我的诊所基地没有可用的房间。

sentences.en: And so on a Tuesday afternoon, I would go in, into the team, sit in the agile office and do my admin.
sentences.zh: 所以在星期二下午，我会去团队所在的灵活办公区，坐在那儿处理行政工作。

sentences.en: It was job planned that I would do my admin, um, so that I at least saw the team.
sentences.zh: 我的工作计划里安排了处理行政工作，呃，这样我至少能见到团队。

sentences.en: Whereas when I went down to three days a week, it just was all that level of moving around was a bit less sustainable.
sentences.zh: 而当我减少到每周工作三天时，所有这种到处奔波的程度就有点难以持续了。

sentences.en: Um, and so I was able to get some rooms, job planned, um, booked in advance.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以我得以通过工作规划弄到一些房间，呃，提前预订好。

sentences.en: I would book them six months in advance on the clinical systems to make sure that I was going to be able to see those clients, support my clients, um, pick up new clients.
sentences.zh: 我会在临床系统上提前六个月预订房间，以确保我能够接待那些客户，支持我的客户，呃，接待新客户。

sentences.en: And, um, you know, support the team and reduce the waiting list because that was really important to me.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，你知道的，支持团队并缩短等待名单，因为这对我来说真的非常重要。

sentences.en: So sometimes you might well be working in a service where you are pioneering, you are wanting to do these things, but processes move slower.
sentences.zh: 所以有时你可能在某个服务机构工作，在那里你是开拓者，你想要做这些事情，但流程进展较慢。

sentences.en: Um, and maybe that might well be a conversation for another day, but it's what I'm passionate about.
sentences.zh: 呃，也许这可以留到改天再讨论，但这是我充满热情的事业。

sentences.en: So let's pause here for a brief break.
sentences.zh: 那么我们在这里稍事休息。

sentences.en: Um, and I'll be back along with one, two, three more strategies to help think about how to organise yourself and be just an all round superstar.
sentences.zh: 呃，我马上回来，还会带来一、二、三条更多的策略，帮助你思考如何组织好自己，成为一个全能巨星。

sentences.en: Catch up with you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快再聊。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Avalon and I'm an undergraduate psychology student.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫阿瓦隆，我是一名本科心理学专业学生。

sentences.en: I recently finished a year long placement as an AP in the NHS and I'm now one week into my final year.
sentences.zh: 我最近在NHS完成了为期一年的助理心理学家（AP）实习，现在刚刚进入我的最后学年一周。

sentences.en: I loved reading the clinical psychologist collective and I couldn't have come across it at a better time.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢阅读《临床心理学家合集》，而且我遇到它的时机再好不过了。

sentences.en: I was starting to panic a bit about my options after uni and reading that there are so many different paths that have ultimately led people to the clinical psychology doctorate was really reassuring.
sentences.zh: 我对大学毕业后的选择开始感到有点恐慌，读到有这么多不同的道路最终通向临床心理学博士学位，这真的让我感到非常安心。

sentences.en: Hearing about people's amazing experiences and wide range of backgrounds has really encouraged me to follow what interests me and to make the most of the journey rather than seeing everything that I do as a step towards the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 听到大家的惊人经历和广泛背景，真的鼓励我去追求自己感兴趣的事物，并充分享受这段旅程，而不是把所做的每一件事都看作是通往博士学位的又一步。

sentences.en: It has also really helped me to reflect on my approach to work in previous years, which wasn't very healthy.
sentences.zh: 这也确实帮助我反思了前几年对待工作的方式，那种方式其实不太健康。

sentences.en: And now I can work on trying to get more balance and put less pressure on myself as I know that these skills will be really important when I'm thinking about applying for the deep in Psy in a few years time.
sentences.zh: 现在我可以努力争取更多的平衡，减少给自己的压力，因为我知道，当我几年后考虑申请临床心理学博士（ClinPsyD）时，这些技能将非常重要。

sentences.en: So how good is that?
sentences.zh: 所以这有多棒呢？

sentences.en: Um, you absolutely don't just take my word for it.
sentences.zh: 呃，你绝对不要只听我一面之词。

sentences.en: Um, take, um, Avalon's word for it too.
sentences.zh: 呃，也听听，呃，阿瓦隆怎么说吧。

sentences.en: Um, it really is worth you checking out.
sentences.zh: 呃，真的很值得你去了解一下。

sentences.en: Okay, so in the first half, um, we were discussing job plans and how they can help you be an all-round superstar, basically, to be able to get what you need to get done, done.
sentences.zh: 好了，所以在前半部分，呃，我们讨论了工作计划以及它们如何帮助你成为一个全能巨星，基本上就是能够完成你需要完成的工作。

sentences.en: Um, so I hope you found that helpful.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以我希望你觉得这有帮助。

sentences.en: Um, my next little, um, tip, um, would be, um, when you are noticing things that you think you might want to talk about in supervision,
sentences.zh: 呃，我的下一个小建议，呃，是当你注意到一些你觉得可能想在督导中讨论的事情时，

sentences.en: is just to be quite honest about that with clients.
sentences.zh: 只要对客户坦诚相告即可。

sentences.en: So, um, I can't reach my diary because it's just over there.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，我够不到我的日记本，因为它就在那边。

sentences.en: But, um, if I'm with a client, I would say, for example, ah, okay, um, I'm not quite sure about that.
sentences.zh: 但是，呃，如果我和客户在一起，我会说，例如，啊，好的，呃，我对那个还不是很有把握。

sentences.en: Or I haven't come across that exact set of circumstances before.
sentences.zh: 或者我以前没有遇到过完全相同的情况。

sentences.en: But what I'm going to do is I'm going to make a note for myself to take that to my next supervision session.
sentences.zh: 但我要做的是，我给自己做个记录，把它带到我的下一次督导会议上去讨论。

sentences.en: Um, and then I'll come back with you and we'll explore that together.
sentences.zh: 呃，然后我会回来找你，我们一起探讨。

sentences.en: Does that sound okay?
sentences.zh: 听起来行吗？

sentences.en: Um, don't be, you know, don't be afraid of saying you don't know the answer.
sentences.zh: 呃，不要，你知道的，不要害怕说你不知道答案。

sentences.en: Um, and what I would do then is I would grab my diary and I would write in the section of my diary,
sentences.zh: 呃，我接下来会做的是，我会拿起我的日记本，在日记本的某个版块写下来，

sentences.en: because I've got an A4 diary, I would write in the section issues for supervision.
sentences.zh: 因为我有一个A4大小的日记本，我会在“督导议题”这一栏里写下来。

sentences.en: Um, so when it comes to supervision, I've already got that list ready to go.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以到了督导的时候，我已经把这个清单准备好了，随时可以拿去讨论。

sentences.en: Um, I'm not having to find additional time to plan in what I need to talk about.
sentences.zh: 呃，我不需要花额外的时间来规划我需要谈论的内容。

sentences.en: Now, of course, you might have a duty of care to discuss clients at set intervals as well, but it always can be useful to go into supervision with set questions, you know?
sentences.zh: 当然，你可能也有关怀职责，需要在设定的时间间隔内讨论客户，但带着明确的问题去参加督导总是很有用的，你知道的？
